newsitem.title: JAPAN: Green Cross shares rise on AIDS drug sales report.
newsitem.headline: Green Cross shares rise on AIDS drug sales report.

text.p: Green Cross Corp shares rose in Thursday morning trade on a newspaper report that it and Bristol-Myers Squibb Co (BMS) had agreed on joint sales of an AIDS drug in Japan, brokers said.
As of 0131 GMT, the shares were up 44 yen at 508.
A Green Cross spokesman said on Thursday that the company was negotiating with BMS regarding sales of BMS's AIDS drug d4T, but that the talks had not yet reached any conclusions.
"We are negotiating over sales of d4T but nothing has yet been decided," the company spokesman said.

The Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Thursday that the two companies had already agreed on joint sales of the drug in Japan and were discussing joint sales of ddI, another BMS AIDS drug which BMS already sells in Japan.
